messages:
maria-support: Hey team — customer AcmeMetrics (free tier) reporting 429s during their nightly ingest window, which runs ~02:00-04:00 UTC. They say it used to be fine but last 2 nights they started getting lots of `429` and webhooks are retrying. Asking for a temporary bump or clear upgrade path. Included logs below.

lisa-cs: Can you paste the example request/headers they saw? Also need the account id and org domain to check throttles.

maria-support: Account ID `org_acme_9982`. Example response snippet from their app: 

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 45
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "message": "request quota exhausted for this minute"
}
```

They said requests are mostly short embeddings calls and some streaming chat. They batch ~30 parallel workers hitting the API concurrently during the window.

sam-eng: Thanks — looks like they're hitting per-minute token request ceilings. Free tier has low concurrency and token throughput caps. Two immediate notes: 1) parallel workers + no jitter will easily spike concurrency; 2) streaming + embeddings both consume tokens and affect quota.

sam-eng: Quick repro steps for us to validate: 1) use their key and run `ab`-style parallel curl: `for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings & done` 2) watch `X-RateLimit-Remaining` on responses and `429`.

maria-support: Customer asking if we can grant a short-term burst window for tonight (one-off) so their backfill completes. They've expressed willingness to upgrade if needed but want to know timeline and cost.

jordan-sales: I can offer a 7-day eval bump to paid tier (sales-assisted trial) if ops can flip a temporary quota for org_acme_9982. What's the minimum we need to change on our side?

sam-eng: Minimum options: a) temporary per-org throughput bump (fastest) b) encourage them to shard across multiple API keys and add jitter (quick mitigation) c) move them to Dedicated/Reserved if sustained high throughput is expected. For tonight a one-off per-org bump of concurrency and tokens for the 02:00-06:00UTC window is doable. Need ops to approve and update quota configs.

lisa-cs: Also flag: their auth shows single key used by all workers — recommend rotating to multiple keys or using multiple API clients to distribute rate-limit buckets. We should send a concise mitigation guide: exponential backoff with 429 handling + jitter + retry-after header parsing.

maria-support: I told them to implement backoff but they said the ingest is a time-limited backfill and retries will just push more load later. They prefer a short quota exception.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Ops change required. Create ticket OPS-7832 to grant temporary throughput + set automatic rollback at 06:00UTC. Add audit log entry.

sam-eng: If ops approves, set these temporary values: per-minute token cap = 500k, max concurrent requests = 120 for that org during window. Also enable prefix caching for embeddings if they re-ingest repeated text to reduce token usage.

jordan-sales: I'll prepare an email with pricing for converting to paid monthly and the 7-day trial uplift. If ops can confirm the temporary bump I'll loop in the CFO for billing waiver for the trial period.

lisa-cs: Customer asked for SLA impact — on free tier there is no uptime SLA. Recommend offering them a trial upgrade so they get at least higher SLOs; mention Dedicated for guaranteed latency and throughput.

maria-support: Ops — can you confirm timeline for the temporary change? Customer waiting.

sam-eng: Also adding a quick code snippet for them to add jittered backoff (node):

```
async function callWithBackoff(fn) {
  let attempt = 0;
  while (attempt < 5) {
    try { return await fn(); } catch (e) {
      if (e.status !== 429) throw e;
      const wait = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 200 + Math.floor(Math.random()*200);
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, wait));
      attempt++;
    }
  }
  throw new Error('exhausted retries');
}
```

maria-support: Thanks — tagging @jordan-sales and @deploy-bot so we can coordinate. Customer iso: wants final answer before 23:00 UTC today.

deploy-bot: OPS-7832 created, owner = ops-aly, ETA for change = 45 minutes after approval. Rollback scheduled at 06:00UTC.

lisa-cs: I'll draft the mitigation steps and the upgrade options for the customer and send as a short checklist.

jordan-sales: Ping me once ops confirms and I'll send trial uplift email + contract details. :thumbsup:

maria-support: Closing loop with customer now and will update thread when ops confirms. Thanks everyone.
